evidence: DevelopmentPrioritizer owns one typed inventory, fixed-point ranking, immutable persistence, and report contract.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep work execution and source lifecycle ownership external.

evidence: Candidates use bounded references instead of joining lifecycle-incompatible project, failure, regression, security, or token-waste stores.
dimensions.recommendation: Add separately reviewed source adapters only when they can prove open-state semantics.

evidence: The closed version-1 request defines six kinds, five integer inputs, explicit inventory claims, evidence, and stable identifiers.
dimensions.recommendation: Version the request before changing score semantics.

evidence: Schema v73 owns immutable ranking snapshots only and does not duplicate or mutate source lifecycle records.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep source references as provenance rather than copied source bodies.

evidence: Tests cover formula arithmetic, all kinds, ties, idempotency, partial inventories, bounds, secrets, immutability, Safe Mode, CLI, migration, and rollback.
dimensions.recommendation: Benchmark ranking usefulness on real completed work before tuning weights or scales.

evidence: Inventory completeness and all value, confidence, frequency, effort, and risk estimates are caller-authored claims.
impact_path: A caller omits work or supplies optimistic estimates.
The deterministic formula accurately ranks the inaccurate inventory.
An operator could over-trust the advisory ordering.
dimensions.recommendation: Require source-specific retained evidence and human review before acting on a ranking.

evidence: Ranking uses integers, hashes, SQLite, and stable sorting with no model, evaluator, network, or provider dependency.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep future model-assisted estimates outside the trusted scoring core.

evidence: Request hashes, visible formula inputs, immutable snapshots, and versioned schemas preserve exact v1 lineage.
dimensions.recommendation: Retain old runs and create a new version for alternative heuristics.
